routes.title: New York → Chicago
routes.blurb: Westbound on I-80 and I-90: the afternoon sun ahead, then dusk on the Indiana Toll Road.

routes.title: Chicago → Denver
routes.blurb: Across Iowa and Nebraska on I-80, chasing the sunset west for the last hours.

routes.title: Los Angeles → Denver
routes.blurb: Out of LA in the evening, through the Utah canyons at night, into sunrise over the Rockies.

routes.title: Dallas → Atlanta
routes.blurb: An early start east on I-20: dawn and the low sun straight ahead across Louisiana.

routes.title: Seattle → San Francisco
routes.blurb: South on I-5: the sun on your right all afternoon, and sunset over the Sacramento Valley.
